# Nyaa query corpus (FR-A4, architecture.md §6, §10).
#
# One **block** per real case, blocks separated by blank lines, `#` lines
# ignored. Every block is a catalogue entry Arc had trouble with, the episode
# it was looking for, the queries it must ask, and real nyaa.si release names
# it must accept and reject. `tests/test_query_corpus.py` asserts all of it
# offline: `queries()` and `acceptable()` are pure functions of an `anime` row,
# so this corpus needs no network and no database.
#
# Fields, one per line, `name: value`:
#
#   case       an id for the failure message. Required, unique.
#   romaji     the entry's `title_romaji`. Required.
#   english    its `title_english`. Omit where the catalogue has none.
#   native     its `title_native`. Omit where it does not matter.
#   synonym    one of its `synonyms`; repeat the line for more.
#   format     its `format`: TV, MOVIE, OVA, ONA, SPECIAL. Required.
#   episodes   its episode count, or `null`.
#   year       its `season_year`, or omit. Only a single (a film, or a
#              one-episode OVA/ONA) compares it with a release's own year.
#   prequel    `yes` when the catalogue says something comes *before* this
#              entry, which is what withholds the bare-head query forms.
#              Defaults to no.
#   prequel_episodes
#              how many episodes that prequel ran. Implies `prequel: yes`,
#              and is what `absolute_offset()` adds up for the absolute
#              query forms and the absolute acceptance rule — the count is
#              the block's own fact, so the corpus stays offline and states
#              no catalogue number it cannot show. The synthetic prequel it
#              builds is a FINISHED TV row, since only a finished season's
#              episode count is a fact rather than an announcement.
#   number     the episode being searched for. Required.
#   query      a query form `queries()` MUST build for it; repeat the line.
#   absent     a form it must NOT build — a bare head that would return the
#              first season of an unmarked sequel. Repeat the line.
#   accept     a release name `acceptable()` MUST accept, optionally with
#              `@seeders=N` for the ranking assertion below. Repeat the line.
#   reject     a release name it MUST reject: a batch, another season, a
#              dubbed-only upload of the wrong show, the wrong film.
#              Repeat the line.
#   prefer     which of the accepted releases `rank()` must put first. One
#              line, and the point of it is the dub rule: a dub with four
#              thousand seeders still ranks below a sub with twelve.
#
# **Why the file exists.** Every case here was a show that sat in `searching`
# on production, retrying every six hours against queries that could not
# match: nine words of catalogue title where the group writes two, a season
# marker written five ways, an episode number written `S01E07`, a star in the
# title, a slash read as a directory, a film asked for as `- 01`. None of them
# was a filter problem, and none of them is visible in a unit test of one
# helper. A query form is a claim about what release groups write, and this is
# where the claims are written down.

case: rakudai-head
# AniList 190123. Nine words of catalogue title in both languages and no
# season marker anywhere, so every form built from a whole title returned 0 on
# 2026-09-12 while `Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musou 01` returned 9.
romaji: Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musou: Nidome no Tensei, S-Rank Cheat Majutsushi Bouken-roku
english: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage
format: TV
episodes: 12
number: 1
query: Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musou - 01
query: From Overshadowed to Overpowered - 01
accept: [SubsPlease] Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musou - 01 (1080p) [ABCD1234].mkv
accept: [Erai-raws] Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musou - 01 [1080p][Multiple Subtitle].mkv
reject: [Erai-raws] Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musou - 01 ~ 12 [1080p][Multiple Subtitle]

case: mushoku-s3-short-forms
# AniList 178789. The season marker sits before the subtitle, so the
# catalogue's title and SubsPlease's name diverge completely.
romaji: Mushoku Tensei III: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu
english: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3
synonym: Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu 3rd Season
format: TV
episodes: 14
number: 11
query: Mushoku Tensei S3 - 11
query: Mushoku Tensei III - 11
query: Mushoku Tensei - 11
query: Mushoku Tensei S03E11
accept: [SubsPlease] Mushoku Tensei S3 - 11 (1080p) [4492A492].mkv
accept: [Erai-raws] Mushoku Tensei III - Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu - 11 [1080p][Multiple Subtitle]
reject: [SubsPlease] Mushoku Tensei - 11 (1080p) [4492A493].mkv
reject: [Erai-raws] Mushoku Tensei S3 - 01 ~ 12 [1080p][Multiple Subtitle]

case: one-room-ta-sxxeyy
# AniList 205068. Every group that has it writes the number the Western way,
# so `One-Room TA - 02` and `One-Room TA 02` both returned 0 and
# `One-Room TA` returned 9.
romaji: Wollum Jogyonim
english: One-Room TA
format: TV
episodes: 7
number: 2
query: One-Room TA S01E02
query: Wollum Jogyonim S01E02
accept: [ToonsHub] One-Room TA S01E02 1080p VIKI WEB-DL AAC2.0 H.264 (Wollum Jogyonim, Multi-Subs)
reject: [Doomdos] - One-Room TA - S01E01-03 [1080p VIKI WEB-DL BATCH]
reject: [geckyzz] One-Room TA - S01 (원룸 조교님; One Room Jogyo-nim) [VIKI.WEB-DL 1080P AVC, AAC, M-SUB][BATCH]

case: made-in-abyss-s2-no-head
# AniList 97986. The one entry a bare head query must not be asked for: its
# title names an arc rather than a season, so nothing on either side marks a
# season and `[SubsPlease] Made in Abyss - 07` — season one's episode 7 —
# passes the filter with a title score of 1.00. The *query* is the only thing
# that can prevent it, which is what `absent` pins.
romaji: Made in Abyss: Retsujitsu no Ougonkyou
english: Made in Abyss - The Golden City of the Scorching Sun
format: TV
episodes: 12
prequel: yes
number: 7
query: Made in Abyss: Retsujitsu no Ougonkyou - 07
query: Made in Abyss Retsujitsu no Ougonkyou - 07
absent: Made in Abyss - 07
absent: Made in Abyss S01E07
accept: [SubsPlease] Made in Abyss - Retsujitsu no Ougonkyou - 07 (1080p) [A1B2C3D4].mkv

case: cowboy-bebop-year-pair
# `1998-1999` is when it aired, not what the torrent holds — and the name
# carries no episode number at all, so nothing in it is episode 5.
romaji: Cowboy Bebop
english: Cowboy Bebop
format: TV
episodes: 26
number: 5
query: Cowboy Bebop - 05
accept: [HorribleSubs] Cowboy Bebop - 05 [1080p].mkv
reject: [Kametsu] Cowboy Bebop 1998-1999 [BD 1080p]
reject: [Kametsu] Cowboy Bebop Complete Series [BD 1080p FLAC]

case: fate-zero-slash
# The slash was read as a path separator, so the parser reported a show called
# "Zero" and the filter rejected every release of the show.

episodes: 13
number: 12
query: Fate/Zero - 12
query: Fate Zero - 12
accept: [SubsPlease] Fate/Zero - 12 (1080p) [ABCD1234].mkv

case: sword-art-online-dub-vs-sub
# Both of these are episode 7 and both are acceptable; the dub had four
# thousand seeders and was what production picked on 2026-09-13, which is the
# ranking rule this pins rather than the filter.
romaji: Sword Art Online
english: Sword Art Online
format: TV
episodes: 25
number: 7
query: Sword Art Online - 07
accept: [Yameii] Sword Art Online - S01E07 [English Dub] [CR WEB-DL 1080p] [F00DBABE].mkv @seeders=4000
accept: [SubsPlease] Sword Art Online - 07 (1080p) [A1B2C3D4].mkv @seeders=12
prefer: [SubsPlease] Sword Art Online - 07 (1080p) [A1B2C3D4].mkv

case: bofuri-dub-group
# `[KaiDubs]` says nothing about its audio except in its own name.

english: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense
format: TV
episodes: 12
number: 7

accept: [KaiDubs] BOFURI I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense - 07 [1080p].mkv @seeders=900

prefer: [SubsPlease] BOFURI - 07 (1080p) [A1B2C3D4].mkv

case: servamp-movie
# One of the three films that sat in `searching` for a day because every query
# Arc built carried `- 01`, which no film release on Nyaa names.
romaji: Servamp Movie: Alice in the Garden
english: Servamp Movie: Alice in the Garden
format: MOVIE
episodes: 1
year: 2018
number: 1
query: Servamp Movie: Alice in the Garden
query: Servamp Movie Alice in the Garden
absent: Servamp Movie: Alice in the Garden - 01
accept: [Erai-raws] Servamp Movie - Alice in the Garden [1080p][Multiple Subtitle].mkv
reject: [Judas] Servamp Movie - Alice in the Garden [BD 1080p][HEVC x265 10bit][BATCH]
# The whole-series Blu-ray pack. It names no episode, no range and no batch
# marker, so "an episode-less single" accepted it — and its title is a strict
# subset of the film's, which the ordinary asymmetric comparison scores 1.00.
# Two rules reject it now: it never says it is a film, and a single's title
# comparison forgives only the type word itself.
reject: [Coalgirls] Servamp (1920x1080 Blu-ray FLAC)
reject: [Judas] Servamp Movie [BD 1080p]

case: kizumonogatari-franchise-siblings
# Three films, one name, no episode number and no year on any of the rips:
# `kizumonogatari` is a strict subset of all three parts and scored 1.00
# against every one of them, so whichever the ranker liked best was "the film".
# The strict title rule is the whole margin here — the year check has nothing
# to work with, which is the ordinary case for a film — and it costs the bare
# `[Coalgirls] Kizumonogatari` rip, which is honestly not distinguishable from
# a series pack by anything in its name.
romaji: Kizumonogatari III: Reiketsu-hen
english: Kizumonogatari Part 3: Reiketsu
format: MOVIE
episodes: 1
year: 2017
prequel: yes
number: 1
query: Kizumonogatari III: Reiketsu-hen
query: Kizumonogatari III Reiketsu-hen
accept: [Moozzi2] Kizumonogatari III Reiketsu-hen Movie [BD 1920x1080 x264 FLAC]
reject: [Coalgirls] Kizumonogatari I Tekketsu-hen Movie [BD 1080p FLAC]
reject: [Coalgirls] Kizumonogatari II Nekketsu-hen Movie [BD 1080p FLAC]
reject: [Coalgirls] Kizumonogatari [BD 1080p]

case: jujutsu-kaisen-s2-absolute
# AniList 145064, and the case absolute numbering was built for (2026-09-17).
# SubsPlease released season two as `- 25` through `- 47` while the catalogue
# numbers that entry 1-23, so `Jujutsu Kaisen S2 - 01` matched nothing and
# `Jujutsu Kaisen - 01` was season *one's* first episode: the episode was
# either not fetched or fetched wrong. Season one ran 24 (the block's own
# count, which is what the offset is read off - never a number guessed from
# the release in front of it), so `- 25` is episode 1 here and `- 24` is still
# season one's last. Both accepted releases pass `acceptable()` on their own;
# which of the two is *taken* when both come back is `filter_items()`' rule,
# and the marked one wins.
romaji: Jujutsu Kaisen 2nd Season
english: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 2
format: TV
episodes: 23
prequel_episodes: 24
number: 1
query: Jujutsu Kaisen S2 - 01
query: Jujutsu Kaisen - 01
query: Jujutsu Kaisen - 25
query: Jujutsu Kaisen 25
accept: [SubsPlease] Jujutsu Kaisen - 25 (1080p) [F7B4A1C2].mkv
accept: [SubsPlease] Jujutsu Kaisen S2 - 01 (1080p) [A1B2C3D4].mkv
reject: [SubsPlease] Jujutsu Kaisen - 01 (1080p) [B2C3D4E5].mkv
reject: [SubsPlease] Jujutsu Kaisen - 24 (1080p) [C3D4E5F6].mkv
reject: [SubsPlease] Jujutsu Kaisen S2 - 25 (1080p) [D4E5F6A7].mkv
reject: [Erai-raws] Jujutsu Kaisen 2nd Season - 25 ~ 47 [1080p][Multiple Subtitle]
